# Jameson Stone

> Personal blog and commonplace book for short notes, archive writing, paintings, and small software projects by Jameson Stone.

Put the AGI in the bag, bro.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://jamesonstone.io/): The blog homepage, latest writing, and a painting from the visual archive.
- [Blog](https://jamesonstone.io/blog/): Complete writing archive.
- [Paintings](https://jamesonstone.io/paintings/): A small visual archive.
- [Projects](https://jamesonstone.io/projects/): Public tools and project records.
- [Reasoning Machines](https://jamesonstone.io/reasoning-machines/): Studio, organizations, products, and research tools.
- [About](https://jamesonstone.io/about/): Profile and contact details.
- [RSS](https://jamesonstone.io/feed.xml): Feed for posts.

## Latest Posts

- [You probably don't need the big model](https://jamesonstone.io/blog/2026/11/10/you-probably-dont-need-the-big-model.html): Most software work is well-trodden CRUD and integration, so start with the cheapest model that works and fix the context before you reach for more intelligence.
- [Relationships die when you stop saying thank you](https://jamesonstone.io/blog/2026/11/10/relationships-die-when-you-stop-saying-thank-you.html): Relationships end when you stop noticing what the other person gives you and stop saying thank you.
- [Memory Systems XV: Emulate, Then Supersede](https://jamesonstone.io/blog/2026/11/08/memory-systems-emulate-then-supersede.html): Emulate the useful parts of human memory, then replace the judgment layer when evidence supports a better one.
- [Memory Systems XIV: The Lake](https://jamesonstone.io/blog/2026/11/08/memory-systems-the-lake.html): Store traces so a later judgment layer can improve, while serve still admits only what a current toward requires.
- [Memory Systems XIII: Capacity](https://jamesonstone.io/blog/2026/11/08/memory-systems-capacity.html): Cheap storage is an advantage. Judgment, not capacity, decides what becomes a memory.

## Public Projects

- [Hyperlite](https://github.com/jamesonstone/hyperlite): A native macOS window and CLI for tracking pull requests, reviews, conflicts, and GitHub Actions across projects.
- [Hyperlite guide](https://github.com/jamesonstone/hyperlite/blob/main/docs/USER_GUIDE.md): Application behavior, keyboard shortcuts, and CLI commands.
- [Kit](https://github.com/jamesonstone/kit): A provider-neutral CLI for agent contracts, contextual rules, project memory, and repository validation.
- [Kit getting started](https://github.com/jamesonstone/kit#how-kit-works): How Kit works and commands for new and existing projects.
- [Mint](https://jamesonstone.io/mint/): Semantic versioning, changelogs, and release automation across production, non-production, and sandbox environments.
- [Mint source](https://github.com/jamesonstone/mint): CLI and GitHub Action source repository for Mint.

## Code Projects

- [kit](https://github.com/jamesonstone/kit): A portable, document-first workflow harness for specs, planning, implementation, review, and handoff.
- [yp](https://github.com/jamesonstone/yp): A tiny path-copying CLI for sending files, directories, or picker selections to the clipboard.
- [kp](https://github.com/jamesonstone/kp): A local prompt utility for keeping reusable coding-agent prompts close at hand in the shell.
- [event-collector](https://github.com/jamesonstone/event-collector): An HTTP service and CLI for collecting generic event envelopes with hash validation and idempotency.
- [sso-testkit](https://github.com/jamesonstone/sso-testkit): A Go CLI for checking SSO readiness with scenario files, token-exchange probes, and redacted reports.
- [radar](https://github.com/jamesonstone/radar): A lightweight process observer for agents.
- [mint](https://github.com/jamesonstone/mint): Version, changelog, and release-state tooling.
- [ding](https://github.com/jamesonstone/ding): Invoice payment tracking and workflow tooling.
- [beacon](https://github.com/jamesonstone/beacon): Signal Layer for Coding Agents.
- [flx](https://github.com/jamesonstone/flx): Source Control Rebuilt for the Agentic Era, with Git-Native Interoperability.
- [hyperlite](https://github.com/jamesonstone/hyperlite): NextGen Signal Layer for Coding Agents.
- [rungrid](https://github.com/jamesonstone/rungrid): Unified Development Workspace Observability.
- [ghostgc](https://github.com/jamesonstone/ghostgc): Garbage Collection for Abandoned AI Coding Runtimes.
- [loopc](https://github.com/jamesonstone/loopc): PID-driven Process Control.
- [kura](https://github.com/jamesonstone/kura): Storehouse of CLI Commands.
- [narrowband](https://github.com/jamesonstone/narrowband): Discovering Meaningful problems worth solving.
- [scout](https://github.com/jamesonstone/scout): Finding Innovative AI Signals via Research Distillation.
- [outpost](https://github.com/jamesonstone/outpost): Durable Alerts From Committed Events.
- [touchstone](https://github.com/jamesonstone/touchstone): Personal Benchmark of LLM Performance and Efficiency.
- [alfred-mac-emoji-picker](https://github.com/jamesonstone/alfred-mac-emoji-picker): Type e or emoji in Alfred to open the built-in macOS emoji picker (Ctrl+Cmd+Space).
## Machine Indexes

- [llms.txt](https://jamesonstone.io/llms.txt): Curated LLM entrypoint for this site.
- [Full public content](https://jamesonstone.io/llms-full.txt): Public pages and published posts as Markdown, generated from the site sources on every build.
- [full-llms.txt](https://jamesonstone.io/full-llms.txt): Identical companion at the requested alternate filename.

## Studios and product sites

- [Site family](https://jamesonstone.io/reasoning-machines/): Dedicated studio and projects directory.
- [Reasoning Machines](https://reasoningmachines.co/): Independent studio for software, systems, and ideas.
- [Applied Symbolics](https://github.com/appliedsymbolics): GitHub organization; its product sites are Ambient OS and OpenCarrier.
- [Ambient OS](https://ambientos.dev/): Operations software marketing site.
- [OpenCarrier](https://opencarrier.dev/): Carrier API marketing site.
- [Limina Dev](https://limina-dev.github.io/): Warehouse and logistics software, including mapr and sortr.
- [Spectral7](https://github.com/spectral7-ltd): Applied AI and operational software spanning logistics, communications, and knowledge systems.
- [Scout](https://scout.jamesonstone.io/): AI research intelligence.
- [Narrowband](https://narrowband.jamesonstone.io/): Software opportunity research.
- [OpenVital](https://openvital.co/): The healthcare AI arm of Reasoning Machines. Medproof is its first product in development.
